title: Navarette v. California (2014)
key_points: Holding: A 911 caller's eyewitness report that a specific vehicle ran her off the road was reliable enough to justify a stop for suspected drunk driving.
officer_notes: Scenario: A 911 caller reports a silver pickup with a given plate just forced her onto the shoulder. You locate it minutes later on the same road and stop it.
Takeaway: Contemporaneous, eyewitness 911 reports of dangerous driving carry weight; document the call details.
